questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped they began the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped began they the journey.
Only after the rain had stopped, they began the journey.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin the journey.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?
options: It was John who broke the window yesterday.
John broke the window yesterday, wasn't it?
John was the one that broke the window yesterday.
The window was broken yesterday by John.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window yesterday.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the conditional sentence that expresses a hypothetical situation in the past which is unlikely to have occurred.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would attend it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?
options: I suggest that the committee meets next week.
I suggest that the committee meeting next week.
I suggest that the committee should meet next week.
I suggest that the committee ought to meet next week.
questions.answer: I suggest that the committee should meet next week.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism.
options: She likes swimming in the sea and to go for walks in the park.
She likes swimming in the sea and walking in the park.
She likes to swim in the sea and to walk in the park.
She likes swimming in the sea and to walk in the park.
questions.answer: She likes swimming in the sea and walking in the park.
